description: Delete the standalone Name wheel ('Name your fate', Monitor/Room 01) entirely from the frontend while keeping the To Die sit-out draw fully working and keeping old backups loadable. The Name wheel is the wheelMode==='free' rendering of the shared 'wheel' screen; the To Die sit-out draw is the wheelMode==='round2' rendering of that same screen and MUST be preserved. Also keep engine backward-compat for the inert `wheel` state field. This is one coherent frontend+engine-compat feature.
steps: In static/app.js, remove the 'wheel' entry from the tabs array (const tabs=[['wheel','Name wheel'], ...]) so the Name wheel no longer appears in the room navigation (#nav) or breadcrumb. Decide and apply coherent renumbering: the remaining five rooms are settings/round1/round2/final/overview. The #nav renders numbers from the tabs index (0{i+1}); after removing wheel they will naturally become 01..05, which is fine. Make sure the breadcrumb line (`BH / MONITOR 0{index} / {LABEL}`) and the renderRoom() tile numbers stay coherent with whatever numbering you choose. If you keep the literal 'MONITOR 01 / ...' strings inside sitoutWheelPage()/other title() calls, ensure they do not reintroduce a 'Name wheel' room; the sit-out draw's title currently says 'MONITOR 01 / TO DIE' which is acceptable to keep or renumber, as long as it is coherent and the To Die draw still renders.

In renderRoom(), remove the wheel tile from the local `config` array (the first entry: ['wheel','01 / RANDOM SELECT','NAME
YOUR FATE.', ... ,'
']). Renumber the remaining tiles' leading labels if you renumbered the nav, keeping them coherent (settings..overview). The #monitors grid must no longer contain a data-open="wheel" tile.

DELETE wheelPage() (the standalone 'Name your fate' screen: SPIN canvas + hub, entry-list textarea bound to wheel.text, Use tournament names / Shuffle / Clear list, the wheel.remove_winner checkbox, and the result area with Remove this entry / Add to tournament roster).

DELETE the free-draw-only helpers used solely by wheelPage(): spinWheel(), randomIndex(), wheelNames(), resetWheelResult() (and remove its call sites), and the globals wheelLast and wheelAngle ONLY IF unused after the sit-out draw is accounted for. CAUTION: wheelAngle IS used by the sit-out draw (animateSitoutPair/drawWheel) — keep wheelAngle. drawWheel() is used by the sit-out draw — keep drawWheel(). resetWheelResult() is called in several non-wheel places (performUndo, restore, reset-all); if you delete it, remove all its call sites too, otherwise keep a no-op or keep it. Choose one consistent approach and make the file syntactically valid.

In the render() content dispatcher, remove the `tab==='wheel'?wheelPage():` branch. Because the sit-out draw currently lives on the 'wheel' tab, you MUST relocate how the sit-out draw is shown so it does not depend on a now-removed Name wheel tab/screen. Preferred approach: keep a dedicated non-navigable screen key for the sit-out draw. Concretely: keep sitoutWheelPage() and route to it. For example, dispatch sitoutWheelPage() when tab is the sit-out key, and have the To Die 'r2-wheel' action and progressRound2() open that key instead of 'wheel'. Pick a key that is NOT in the tabs array (so it stays out of the nav) — e.g. reuse 'wheel' purely as an internal, non-tab screen key, OR introduce 'sitout'. Whatever you choose: (a) the sit-out draw must render exactly as before, (b) it must be reachable from To Die via 'View sit-out wheel' and via the automatic draw animation after r2-done/r2-start, and (c) it must NOT appear as a selectable room in #nav or #monitors. Update openScreen/closeScreen lastMonitor handling, the render() `if(tab===...)drawWheel(...)` call, and any data-open/data-tab references accordingly.

Remove the standalone-wheel click-dispatcher actions and bindings that belonged ONLY to wheelPage(): 'spin', 'remove-winner', 'roster-winner', 'wheel-roster', 'wheel-shuffle', 'wheel-clear', and the wheel.remove_winner checkbox handling via data-check='wheel.remove_winner'. Keep 'r2-wheel' and 'r2-scores' (To Die). Keep the wheelMode machinery ONLY to the extent the sit-out draw needs it; wheelModeTabs() renders two buttons ('Open name draw' free / 'To Die sit-out draw' round2) — since the free name draw is gone, remove the free/name-draw tab button and either remove wheelModeTabs() entirely or reduce it so it no longer offers a path to a deleted screen. Ensure sitoutWheelPage() does not call a wheelModeTabs() that still references the deleted 'free' mode. Also remove the 'input' listener special-case `if(el.dataset.path==='wheel.text')resetWheelResult()` if wheel.text is no longer edited anywhere.

In render(), the legacy_round2 notice currently reads: 'To Live, names, the wheel, and settings are preserved.' Update that copy so it no longer promises a wheel UI (e.g. 'To Live, names, and settings are preserved.'). The underlying `wheel` data may still be archived/kept in the file, but the message must not reference a wheel screen.

In the 'reset-all' action, the fresh state literal currently seeds wheel:{text:'',remove_winner:false} and settings including start_at:''. KEEP seeding `wheel:{text:'',remove_winner:false}` so the client-built fresh state matches engine.new_state() and stays schema-valid (the server re-validates it). Do NOT drop the wheel key from this literal. Keep start_at:'' too. The confirm() copy mentioning 'wheel' may be simplified but keep it valid.

In static/style.css, remove wheel-ONLY selectors that are no longer referenced: .wheel-mini (the removed tile art) and the .monitor-wheel tile color rule and any .monitor-wheel sizing in media queries. DO NOT remove selectors the sit-out draw still renders: .wheel-layout, .wheel-stage, .wheel-wrap, #wheel-canvas, .wheel-hub, .sitout-hub, .wheel-result, .draw-help, and .wheel-modes IF you keep any mode tabs. If you fully removed wheelModeTabs(), you may also remove .wheel-modes. Also remove .entry-editor and its rules only if nothing else uses it (it was wheelPage-only). Grep the final app.js for each class before deleting its CSS to confirm it is unused.

In static/index.html, remove any Name-wheel-specific copy if present (there is no static #wheel-canvas; the meta description mentions 'draw your players' which may be left or lightly reworded — do not over-edit). The #monitors grid is JS-rendered so no static wheel tile exists there.

Update README.md: remove or rewrite the 'Name your fate' monitor bullet in the 'Monitor control room' list, the dedicated '## Name wheel' section, and any sentence that tells users to use the Name wheel to add players. Players are now entered directly in Players & rules. KEEP the 'Automatic Round 2 sit-out wheel' section (that is the To Die draw and still exists). Keep mentions that backups still preserve legacy wheel data if you keep the archival wording accurate.
Run node --check static/app.js and fix any syntax errors (unterminated template literals are the main risk when deleting large template-string functions).

In engine.py: make NO change that breaks backward-compat. Specifically KEEP the `wheel` block in new_state() ({'text':'','remove_winner':False}) and in validate() (s.setdefault('wheel', {...}) then the dict/str/bool checks). Keep schema version 4. No migration bump. The field is now inert (UI never surfaces it) but old backups containing a populated wheel object must still validate and load. If you prefer to stop emitting wheel from new_state(), you may, but ONLY if validate() still tolerates both presence and absence AND the existing tests (test_wheel_large_lists_migration_and_validation expects migrated['wheel']['text']=='' when wheel is absent) still pass; the SAFER path that keeps all current tests green is to leave new_state() and validate() exactly as they are.
acceptance_criteria: The rendered room navigation (#nav) and the #monitors grid contain NO 'Name wheel' / data-open='wheel' room; there is no 'Name your fate' screen reachable from the UI.
node --check static/app.js passes (file is syntactically valid).

The To Die sit-out draw still renders: sitoutWheelPage() still produces the 'Two sit out. Six play.' screen with the sit-out pair, reachable from To Die's 'View sit-out wheel' button and from the automatic draw after marking a match done.

No dangling references remain to deleted functions/actions (grep app.js shows no calls to wheelPage, spinWheel, roster-winner, wheel-roster, wheel-shuffle, wheel-clear, remove-winner, or a 'free' wheel mode path).
engine.new_state() and engine.validate() still accept/represent the inert `wheel` field; schema version stays 4; no migration added.
Removed CSS selectors are confirmed unused by grepping the final app.js; selectors used by the sit-out draw are retained.
README no longer advertises a Name wheel screen for entering players, but still documents the To Die sit-out draw.
verification: grep -nE "wheelPage|data-open=\"wheel\"|'spin'|roster-winner|wheel-roster|wheel-shuffle|wheel-clear|data-wheel-mode=\"free\"" static/app.js  (expect no live/active references to the removed Name wheel)
python3 -c "import engine; s=engine.new_state(); assert 'wheel' in s and s['wheel']=={'text':'','remove_winner':False}; print('new_state wheel ok')"

python3 -c "import engine,copy; s=engine.new_state(); s['wheel']={'text':'Aaron\nGhost','remove_winner':True}; v=engine.validate(copy.deepcopy(s)); assert v['wheel']['text']=='Aaron\nGhost'; print('old backup wheel validates ok')"
findings:
Deleted the standalone Name wheel ('Name your fate') entirely from the frontend while keeping the To Die sit-out draw fully working.

REMOVED from static/app.js: the ['wheel','Name wheel'] entry in the tabs array; the wheel tile from renderRoom()'s config array; the whole wheelPage() function; wheelModeTabs(); spinWheel(); randomIndex(); the wheelNames() const; the globals wheelMode and wheelLast; the free-wheel click actions ('spin','wheel-clear','wheel-roster','wheel-shuffle','remove-winner','roster-winner') and the data-wheelMode handler; the input listener special-case `if(el.dataset.path==='wheel.text')resetWheelResult()`. In render() removed the `tab==='wheel'?wheelPage()` branch.

SIT-OUT DRAW REACHABILITY: moved the sit-out draw off the removed 'wheel' tab onto a dedicated NON-NAVIGABLE screen key 'sitout' (not present in the tabs array, so it never shows in #nav or #monitors). render() now dispatches `tab==='sitout'?sitoutWheelPage()` and calls `drawWheel(sitoutCandidates()...)` when tab==='sitout'. The To Die 'r2-wheel' action now does `openScreen('sitout')`, and progressRound2() sets `tab='sitout'` (instead of wheelMode='round2';tab='wheel') before animateSitoutPair(). The breadcrumb special-cases 'sitout' => 'BH / MONITOR 03 / TO DIE'. Default global tab changed from 'wheel' to 'settings'.

RETAINED (sit-out draw needs them): sitoutWheelPage(), sitoutCandidates(), animateSitoutPair(), drawWheel() (default param changed from wheelNames() to []), the dynamically-created #wheel-canvas, and globals wheelAngle, spinning, sitoutBusy, sitoutAnimating. resetWheelResult() kept (now only resets wheelAngle, since wheelLast is gone) because it is still called from performUndo, restore, and reset-all; all call sites intact.

ENGINE BACKWARD-COMPAT: engine.py left EXACTLY as-is. new_state() still returns wheel:{text:'',remove_winner:false}; validate() still does s.setdefault('wheel',{...}) plus the dict/str/bool checks; schema version stays 4; no migration added. The client 'reset-all' fresh-state literal still seeds wheel:{text:'',remove_winner:false} and settings.start_at:''. Verified: new_state wheel ok; an old backup state with a populated wheel ({'text':'Aaron\nGhost','remove_winner':True}) validates and preserves the text; a live PUT of such a backup with restore:true returned 200 and preserved wheel.text.

ROOM RENUMBERING: with 'wheel' removed the five rooms are now 01..05: settings=01, round1=02, round2=03, final=04, overview=05. Updated renderRoom() tile leading labels, the settings() title ('MONITOR 02'->'MONITOR 01'), overview() title ('MONITOR 06'->'MONITOR 05'), and the sit-out page/breadcrumb to 'MONITOR 03 / TO DIE'. The #nav numbers derive from tabs index (0{i+1}) so they are naturally 01..05. ROUND 01/02/03 labels on the round screens refer to rounds, not monitor numbers, and were left as-is.

CSS (static/style.css): removed wheel-ONLY selectors confirmed unused by grepping the final app.js: .monitor-wheel, .wheel-actions (standalone rule + from two combined selector lists), .entry-editor (standalone block + from the two combined selectors and the max-width:800px media rule), .wheel-result.is-spinning, and .wheel-modes (standalone + from a combined selector; wheelModeTabs() fully removed). .wheel-mini had no CSS rule to remove (only referenced in the deleted config tile). KEPT selectors the sit-out draw renders: .wheel-layout, .wheel-stage, .wheel-wrap, #wheel-canvas, .wheel-hub, .sitout-hub, .wheel-result (+ .wheel-result button), .draw-help.

HTML (static/index.html): meta description 'draw your players' reworded to 'enter your players'; 'SIX ROOMS. ONE TOURNAMENT.' -> 'FIVE ROOMS. ONE TOURNAMENT.'. (The <title> em dash is pre-existing brand copy, left untouched.)

README.md: removed the 'Name your fate' monitor bullet; six-room -> five-room; deleted the '## Name wheel' section; rewrote '## To Live per-game teams' intro to say players are entered directly in Players & rules; updated the sit-out section's mode mention; dropped the wheel Spin example from the self-explaining-controls bullet; reworded the migration/backup line to note legacy wheel data is still accepted and preserved; 'all six monitors'/'overlapping wheel clicks' -> 'all five monitors' (browser test is not run here). Kept the '## Automatic Round 2 sit-out wheel' section.

VERIFICATION: node --check static/app.js => OK. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests => Ran 44 tests, OK. Live probe: GET / 200, GET /app.js 200, PUT old-wheel backup 200, GET /api/backup 200, wheel.text preserved. grep of final app.js shows no live references to wheelPage/spinWheel/randomIndex/wheelNames/wheelModeTabs/wheelLast/wheelMode or the removed actions (only sitoutWheelPage remains). node tests/test_ui.cjs FAILS at line 42 ('sitout' !== 'wheel') because the harness still asserts the old free-wheel/'wheel' tab behavior; this is the EXPECTED pre-FEAT-003 failure called out in the plan and will be reconciled when FEAT-003 updates and runs the tests. The sit-out draw itself renders correctly via the new 'sitout' key.
